document.abstract: The high costs of modern equipment dictate that individual units must be used by more than one activity within television facilities to maximize return on investment. This shared use requires flexible control systems which can accomodate present and future equipment.

authors.affiliation: Dynair Electronics, Inc. San Diego, California
authors.bio: Thomas Meyer was Product Manager for Tele Motion from 1972 to 1977. Since 1977, he has been Product Manager for Dynair. He is an Active Member of the SMPTE Working Group for Standardization of Digital Control of Television Equipment T14.10.
authors.name: Thomas R. Meyer
